g.text: Account -> subscription -> cycles, one target cycle / one fee.
Balance + immutable ledger + paid cycle + rights + request outcome
are one transaction. These are responsibilities, not JPA entities.
CR-CAN-003: DB receipt after confirmed durable intent.
Late receipt -> terminal failure; accepted lost ACK -> replay.
Protocol implementation and boundary tests remain REVIEW.
+cancel(id: UUID, dto: CancellationRequest, caller: Caller): OperationResult
+operation(name: Operation, requestId: String, caller: Caller): OperationResult
+trigger(code: JobCode, runKey: String, date: LocalDate): JobRun
+claim(caller: Caller, op: Operation, id: String, canonical: Bytes): Claim
+lookup(caller: Caller, op: Operation, id: String): OperationResult
+credit(claim: Claim, account: UUID, amount: long): FinancialResult
+consume(claim: Claim, cycle: UUID, account: UUID, amount: long): FinancialResult
+register(claim: Claim, root: UUID, expectedVersion: long): SubscriptionResult
+persistIntent(claim: Claim, root: UUID, expectedVersion: long): PendingIntent
+extendLocked(root: Subscription, target: CycleKey, quote: PriceSnapshot): PaidCycle
+applyLocked(account: Account, delta: long, eligibility: Eligibility): BalanceChange
+getOrCreate(caller: Caller, queryRequestId: String, filters: ReportFilter): ReportQuery
+page(query: UUID, cursor: String, limit: int): ConsumptionPage
+verify(cursor: String, caller: Caller, filters: ReportFilter): PageBoundary
+insertUniqueContribution(source: UUID, period: UUID, kind: Kind): void
+getOrCreate(code: JobCode, runKey: String, cutoff: Instant): JobRun
+checkpoint(run: UUID, fence: long, cursor: String): void
